Land held for communities; family plots allocated by traditional leaders and the RDC; cannot be sold.

front: When did fast-track land reform begin?
Which constitutional chapter covers agricultural land?

back: A1: smallholder plots. A2: larger commercial farms.

front: Why was land reform slow in the 1980s?
back: Willing-buyer willing-seller: only land offered for sale could be bought, often at high prices.

front: Two recognised problems of fast-track land reform?
back: Fall in commercial output in the early 2000s; job losses for farm workers (also tenure insecurity).
